name: Petit's Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Southeastern nigeria and cameroon to northeastern democratic republic of the congo, western uganda, and western kenya
description: A forest-dwelling cuckooshrike in which males and females are strikingly different. Males are entirely black with a greenish gloss.

name: Serra do Mar Tyrant-Manakin
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern minas gerais, rio de janeiro, and eastern são paulo)
description: Rather nondescript manakin that may resemble a flycatcher. Mostly olive green, but notable features include a yellow crown and paler chin.

name: Wood Snipe
rangeDescription: Breeds himalayas and tibet; winters india and southeastern asia
description: A rare and infrequently-seen snipe. Like others of its family, it is cryptically colored and intricately patterned with black, brown, and white.

name: Negros Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Philippines (panay and negros)
description: A fairly small owl of lowland and foothill forest on the islands of Negros and Panay, where it is the only scops-owl. Dark brown above and pale gray below, with a rufous face bordered with a black line and a pale gray V-shape between the eyes.

name: Red-billed Duck
rangeDescription: Locally in eastern and southern africa, and madagascar
description: This small duck has a solidly chocolate-brown ‘skull cap’, white cheeks, and a distinctive pink-red bill with a dark saddle. In flight, the buff flight feathers with a black stripe are distinctive on otherwise all-brown wings.

name: Paradise Riflebird
rangeDescription: Eastern australia (dawes range, queensland to bellinger river, new south wales)
description: Large songbird with a very long decurved bill. Male almost completely black, with green and blue metallic sheen on belly, throat, and crown.

name: Caucasian Grouse
rangeDescription: Caucasus mountains, from far southwestern russia eastward to northeastern azerbaijan and southward to northeastern turkey, armenia, and far northwestern iran
description: Large gamebird endemic to the mountains of the Caucasus region. Male is jet-black with a tiny white patch on the shoulder, a tail that curves downwards at the tip, and flaming red “eyebrows.” White underwing patches are displayed during jumping lekking display.

name: Naga Wren-Babbler
rangeDescription: Hill forest of nagaland and northern manipur
description: A tiny bird that skulks in the dense undergrowth of evergreen forests, particularly around running water. Brown above with a large white throat patch and belly.

name: Bachman's Warbler
rangeDescription: Formerly southeastern usa; wintered to cuba and bahamas (probably extinct)
description: Jewel of a warbler, probably extinct. Male is distinctive, with a black patch on the lower throat and chest.

name: Biak Paradise-Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A fairly common, long-tailed kingfisher of primary and degraded forest on Biak Island where it is the only paradise-kingfisher. White underparts, rump and long tail with large spatules, thick red bill, dark blue upperparts and pale blue flecked head, shoulder patch and narrow part of the tail.

name: Plain Gerygone
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (sawu, rote, timor, and wetar)
description: A tiny, warbler-shaped songbird confined to the eastern Lesser Sundas. Upperparts gray-brown; underparts clean, unmarked white.

name: Dickcissel
rangeDescription: Breeds eastern north america; winters to southern mexico to northern south america
description: Sparrowlike bird known for gathering in enormous wintering flocks in South America. Males are striking with yellow breast, black patch on throat, and rufous shoulders.

name: Flores Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Flores (lesser sundas)
description: A small owl with yellow eyes, a pale bill, an unmarked rufous face and ear tufts, a pale forehead, mainly rufous upperparts with prominent white spots in the wings, and a faintly-scaled pale grayish underside. Juvenile is largely pale rufous, with little barring but strong tail bands.

name: Plain Bush-hen
rangeDescription: Philippines (except palawan)
description: A large ground bird of grass, scrub, and forest edge, usually close to water. Slate-gray on the head and underparts, blending to a brown back and tail.

name: Snow Mountain Quail
rangeDescription: Alpine grassland of snow mountains (west-central new guinea)
description: A huge quail of alpine grasslands. Plump, yellow bill and legs, black bars and white streaks on the back.

name: White-eared Catbird
rangeDescription: Northwestern new guinea eastward to southeastern cenderawasih bay, including raja ampat islands (off western new guinea)
description: A large, shy, stocky bird of lowland and foothill forest interior of western New Guinea. A dark brown crown edged with black, contrasting with white cheek and throat, containing small black dots forming an uneven moustache.

name: Marsh Warbler
rangeDescription: Europe to central russia; winters to coastal southeastern africa (kwazulu-natal)
description: Medium-sized brown warbler, very similar to Eurasian Reed-Warbler. Best differentiated by the song, which is delightful, distinctive, loud, and full of mimicry of European and African birds.

name: Whistling Dove
rangeDescription: Southwestern fiji (kadavu and ono)
description: A unique Fijian dove. Male’s combination of bright yellow head, green body, and yellow undertail is diagnostic.

name: St. Lucia Thrasher
rangeDescription: Dry forest of lowlands of st. lucia (lesser antilles)
description: A ground-feeding denizen found locally in wooded ravines and valleys with thick low vegetation. It somewhat resembles both Brown and Gray Tremblers in shape but it has bold white underparts and a dark red eye, which the tremblers lack.

name: Sumba Brown Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sumba (lesser sundas)
description: An unremarkable drab, brown flycatcher, gray-brown above and pale below. Note the pale base to the bill.
